accessibility_service.reason_for_trigger: DEX signature scanner utilized a naive substring lookup (b'AccessibilityService' in dex_data) which matched fully-qualified package naming, import paths, or developer documentation strings inside classes.dex instead of verified Dalvik descriptors.
accessibility_service.mitigation: Replaced substring matching with evidence-based descriptor matching targeting Landroid/accessibilityservice/AccessibilityService; method signature markers, with fallback matching enabled only for plaintext mock APK environments.

runtime_exec.reason_for_trigger: DEX scanner looked up presence of b'Runtime' and b'exec' anywhere in the classes.dex stream, matching unrelated logging lines, URLs, variable names, or other references.
runtime_exec.mitigation: Replaced with evidence-based Dalvik method descriptor signature lookup targeting Ljava/lang/Runtime;->exec, gating loose substring evaluations to fallback/mock parsing modes only.

suspicious_url.reason_for_trigger: The URL matching pattern identified any URL containing the word 'bypass' or 'verify' ('overview' containing 'verify' or developer docs matching keyword criteria) as suspicious without validating the domain context.
suspicious_url.mitigation: Implemented an official domain allowlist bypassing scans for developer.android.com, android.com, google.com, and firebase.google.com.
